summary: Transform your approach to risk with our Auditing and Risk Management training designed for senior leaders. Gain insights to drive strategic success.
lede: Auditing and Risk Management for Senior Management equips senior leaders to evaluate internal controls, define risk appetite, interpret audit findings, and connect risk data to corporate strategy. Grounded in the IIA Three Lines Model and the COSO ERM Framework, it turns scattered compliance information into structured executive oversight focused on resilience and organizational value. Through hands-on executive oversight, participants learn to design Key Risk Indicators, validate internal control matrices, assess audit committee charters, build executive risk dashboards, and develop strategic mitigation action plans. They also learn to use AI-assisted risk scoring models and Governance, Risk, and Compliance platforms for continuous monitoring, enabling clearer reporting of risk exposures and stronger integration of audit insights into strategic planning.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for senior leaders and executives responsible for overseeing corporate governance, interpreting audit results, and directing enterprise risk strategy.
modules: Executive Oversight of the Audit Function
Digital Transformation and AI in Risk Management
Strategic Risk Mitigation and Resource Allocation
prerequisites: Participants must have a working knowledge of general corporate governance and basic financial reporting principles. No prior technical auditing or coding experience is required. Participants should bring a laptop to access digital GRC dashboard templates and participate in interactive risk scoring exercises.
